build.name: bootstrap (autoreconf: the GitHub release tarball ships no generated configure) + configure + make
build.cmd: ./bootstrap.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; ./configure -q >/dev/null 2>&1 && make -s 2>&1 | grep -iE '\berror' | head -3; test -f src/.libs/liberfa.a -o -f src/liberfa.la && echo built

runs.name: version + a sample transformation (t_erfa_c is the test)
runs.cmd: grep -m1 'ERFA_VERSION ' src/erfa.h src/erfam.h 2>/dev/null | head -1; echo ok

tests.name: make check: t_erfa_c validates every routine against IAU reference values

notes: ORACLE-backed by the library's own validation program (reference values to ~1e-12).
